title: RefineAnything: Multimodal Region-Specific Image Refinement
summary: A diffusion-based framework designed for high-precision local image editing and restoration. It specializes in correcting fine-grained details like text, logos, and intricate structures while ensuring perfect background consistency through a focus-and-refine strategy.
research_notes: Built on the Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 architecture; features a unique Boundary Consistency Loss to ensure seamless blending of refined patches into the original image.

evolution.summary: Launched in April 2026 alongside paper arXiv:2604.06870, the project released inference scripts, model checkpoints, and a live Hugging Face demo. It has since been integrated into ComfyUI and received critical environment pinning updates to resolve color shift issues.
